Mobile apps have many persistence options: fmdb, coredata, realm, which is powerful, and archive, among others.
As we know, SQL-style storage supports basic data types rather than storing Object instances directly. Realm supports objects, but switching an existing SQL-based project can be costly.
If you use SQL but need to store a few objects, or your app only needs a small amount of persistent data, archiving can meet the requirement.
I therefore wrapped this in WZXArchiver to make archiving and unarchiving effortless. Here is how I did it. Better approaches and suggestions are welcome in the comments!
